summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation filed a Form 6-K with exhibits comprising a Form of Proxy and a Notice of Special Meeting of Shareholders and Joint Management Information Circular dated August 26, 2026, for a special meeting scheduled for October 14, 2026. The filing is a routine proxy solicitation and meeting notice under Canadian corporate practice, equivalent to a U.S. proxy statement. No transaction terms, deal structure, premium, or strategic event details are disclosed. The special meeting agenda likely involves routine corporate matters. This is not a special-situation event; it is a standard shareholder meeting notification.
